sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 42148 of 2023
Applicant :- Rachit
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :-
Perdeep Kumar Vishnoi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the impugned charge sheet dated 08.10.2022 as well as cognizance order dated 17.04.2023 in Special Case No. 114 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 0360 of 2022 under Sections 354A, 363, 376(3) I.P.C. and Section 4(2) of POCSO Act, P.S. Awala, District Bareilly pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act, Bareilly.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act, Bareilly
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further prayed to stay the further proceeding of the aforesaid case.
It is submitted that initially an F.I.R. under Section 354 Cr.P.C. was lodged against the applicant.
The allegations were made that the informant stated that when her daughter was going to the house of her uncle, the applicant caught her hand to outrage her modesty.
The victim during her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. stated that when she was sitting inside her house, the applicant came there and took her in a 'gher' and committed rape with her.

It is further submitted that there is Rachit vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3330727/
1 material contradictions in the F.I.R. as well as in the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
and 164 Cr.P.C.

entities.text: Rachit vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that medical report did not corroborate the version of F.I.R., no injury were found on her.

Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that victim during her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
has stated that she did not disclose the entire story to her mother.
In her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that applicant has committed rape with her.
It is further submitted that contradictions cannot be considered at this stage since charge sheet under Section 354A, 363 and 376(3) I.P.C. and section 4(2) of POCSO Act has been submitted.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record, the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, is refused.

However, it is provided that in case the applicant applies for bail within a period of 30 days from today, his application for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 30 days or till the applicant surrenders and applies for bail, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
With the above observations, the application is finally disposed of.
